description_en: A standalone stakeholder map linking coal mining licences, SOE shareholding, IUP/IUPK holders, BUMS groups, domestic PLTU and industrial buyers, export logistics, fiscal receipts and public oversight.
description_id: Peta pemangku kepentingan yang menghubungkan perizinan batubara, kepemilikan BUMN, pemegang IUP/IUPK, grup swasta, pembeli PLTU dan industri, logistik ekspor, penerimaan fiskal, serta pengawasan publik.
notes_en: Mining concessions and RKAB/HBA/DMO oversight belong to ESDM's Minerba authorities, not to Danantara or company shareholders. A coal IUP/IUPK is different from an upstream oil/gas PSC.
MIND ID's direct PT Bukit Asam holding, the broader Danantara portfolio, private coal groups and PLN coal demand are analytically linked but do not form a single chain of corporate command.
The 2025 coal GDP, coal production, coal DMO and Minerba-wide PNBP series have different populations and accounting methods: never add or substitute them.
notes_id: Pengawasan izin tambang dan RKAB/HBA/DMO merupakan kewenangan instansi Minerba ESDM, bukan Danantara atau pemegang saham perusahaan. IUP/IUPK batubara berbeda dari KKS hulu migas.
Kepemilikan PTBA oleh MIND ID, portofolio Danantara, grup tambang swasta dan permintaan PLN terkait secara analitis tetapi bukan satu rantai atasan langsung.
PDB batubara, produksi batubara, DMO dan PNBP seluruh minerba tahun 2025 berbeda cakupan dan basis akuntansi; jangan dicampur atau dijumlahkan.

groups.en: Public policy, fiscal and SOE rights
groups.id_label: Kebijakan publik, fiskal, dan hak BUMN

groups.en: Licensing, HBA, RKAB and environmental control
BUMN mining, PLN and public infrastructure
groups.id_label: BUMN tambang, PLN, dan infrastruktur publik

items.name: President / DEN — national energy direction
items.summary_en: Sets national energy-security direction; production ceilings, statutory permits and mine operating decisions belong to legally designated institutions.
items.summary_id: Menetapkan arah ketahanan energi nasional; kuota produksi, izin, dan operasi tambang menjadi kewenangan instansi masing-masing.

items.name: Ministry of ESDM / Minister
items.summary_en: Sets ministerial coal-mining rules, domestic supply priorities, mine governance and energy-sector supervision. Do not confuse ministerial policy with corporate coal sales.
items.summary_id: Menetapkan kebijakan pertambangan batubara, prioritas pasokan domestik dan pengawasan sektor; berbeda dari penjualan komersial operator.

items.name: Ministry of Finance / fiscal policy
items.summary_en: National budget, tax, state-revenue and mineral-coal non-tax revenue oversight; PNBP Minerba is not coal-only receipts.
items.summary_id: Kebijakan APBN, perpajakan, dan PNBP minerba; realisasi PNBP minerba tidak sama dengan penerimaan batubara saja.

items.name: BP BUMN — strategic SOE rights
items.summary_en: Represents the state's special shareholder and regulatory interests in Indonesian SOEs, not mine-permit approvals for independent companies.
items.summary_id: Mengelola hak pemegang saham khusus negara dan tata kelola BUMN, bukan izin tambang bagi perusahaan swasta.

items.name: Danantara Indonesia — SOE investment
items.summary_en: Portfolio and capital-allocation layer for national SOEs. MIND ID and its mining subsidiaries have their own legal and commercial operating structures; private listed miners are not Danantara subsidiaries.
items.summary_id: Pengelola portofolio dan modal BUMN; MIND ID beserta anak perusahaan tambangnya tetap memiliki tata kelola operasional masing-masing. Perusahaan swasta bukan anak usaha Danantara.

items.name: Ministry of Investment / BKPM
items.summary_en: Investment promotion and risk-based licensing interfaces for coal, processing, logistics and industrial investments; mineral concession approvals follow the applicable Minerba regime.
items.summary_id: Fasilitasi investasi dan antarmuka perizinan usaha berbasis risiko; izin konsesi minerba mengikuti regulasi tersendiri.

items.name: National Energy Council Secretariat (DEN)
items.summary_en: The DEN Secretariat General coordinates energy-policy studies and administration. It is not a government ministry of its own and does not issue mineral-coal mining permits.
items.summary_id: Sekretariat Jenderal DEN mengoordinasikan kajian dan administrasi kebijakan energi. Bukan kementerian tersendiri dan tidak menerbitkan izin usaha pertambangan minerba.

items.name: Directorate General of Minerals & Coal
items.summary_en: Responsible for technical Minerba rules, RKAB and mining-business oversight, reference prices (HBA/HPB), DMO and sector administration. It is a government regulator, not producer.
items.summary_id: Regulator pusat minerba untuk RKAB, HBA/HPB, kepatuhan pertambangan dan DMO. Bukan badan usaha produsen batubara.

items.name: ESDM Mining Inspectors
items.summary_en: Inspect technical compliance, mine safety and good-mining practice within statutory mandates; not production off-takers or holding-company directors.
items.summary_id: Memeriksa kepatuhan teknis, keselamatan dan kaidah pertambangan yang baik menurut mandat; bukan pembeli atau pengelola korporasi.

items.name: ESDM HBA / HPB pricing administration
items.summary_en: Publishes reference coal prices for tax/royalty reference calculations; HBA is not the realized FOB price of every cargo or a fixed universal DMO selling price.
items.summary_id: Menetapkan acuan harga batubara bagi basis perhitungan PNBP; HBA bukan harga transaksi setiap kargo maupun otomatis harga DMO semua pengguna.

items.name: Ministry of Environment / BPLH
items.summary_en: Environmental approvals, pollution enforcement, coal-ash and mining impacts under law; distinct from mineral production permits and coal-sale contracts.
items.summary_id: Persetujuan lingkungan, pengawasan polusi, dan dampak pertambangan termasuk residu batubara; bukan pemegang izin operasi produksi.

items.name: Ministry of Forestry
items.summary_en: Forest-zone use, rehabilitation and land-use interface for mining sites under applicable permits; forestry authorisation does not itself confer coal-production rights.
items.summary_id: Persetujuan penggunaan kawasan hutan serta rehabilitasi di kawasan tambang; bukan kewenangan langsung memberi hak produksi batubara.

items.name: Geological Agency (Badan Geologi)
items.summary_en: Geological exploration/resource datasets; inferred coal resources and proven mine reserves differ and should not be summed as if physically available for current shipments.
items.summary_id: Pemetaan sumber daya geologi; sumber daya dan cadangan batubara bukan kategori yang sama dan tidak setara dengan pasokan siap kirim.

items.name: MIND ID — Indonesian mining SOE holding
items.summary_en: Mining-sector corporate holding of PT Bukit Asam and other strategic mining assets. Direct coal production remains within PTBA and its operating subsidiaries.
items.summary_id: Holding korporasi tambang yang membawahi PT Bukit Asam serta aset pertambangan lain; produksi batubara dilakukan PTBA dan perusahaan operasinya.

items.name: PT Bukit Asam Tbk (PTBA)
items.lead: MIND ID member · coal mining operator
items.summary_en: State-linked publicly listed coal producer with mines in South Sumatra and domestic PLTU supply; MIND ID states a 65.93% shareholding in PTBA (check current issuer register).
items.summary_id: Produsen batubara terbuka grup BUMN dengan tambang Sumatra Selatan serta pasokan bagi PLTU; menurut MIND ID kepemilikannya 65,93%, perlu cocokkan daftar pemegang saham terbaru.

items.name: PT PLN (Persero) — power-sector buyer
items.summary_en: Plans electricity system requirements and thermal-fuel demand through its generation portfolio; coal purchase and operation are distributed across subsidiaries and contract mandates.
items.summary_id: Menentukan kebutuhan sistem listrik dan permintaan energi primer; pengadaan dan operasi PLTU dilaksanakan bersama entitas grup dan kontrak terkait.

items.name: PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia (PLN EPI)
items.id_name: PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia (PLN EPI)
items.summary_en: Authorized procurement executor for coal needed by PLN / PLN Indonesia Power / PLN Nusantara Power; fuel requirements are set by relevant generators.
items.summary_id: Pelaksana kuasa pengadaan batubara untuk kebutuhan PLN/PLN IP/PLN NP; kebutuhan bahan bakar ditetapkan pengelola PLTU terkait.

items.name: PT PLN Indonesia Power
items.summary_en: Runs and maintains generating assets, including coal-fired power plants; fuel consumption and commissioning are plant-specific.
items.summary_id: Mengelola dan mengoperasikan pembangkit termasuk PLTU; realisasi pemakaian batubara dan kapasitas harus ditelusuri per unit pembangkit.

items.name: PT PLN Nusantara Power
items.summary_en: SOE power generation subsidiary with dispatch and plant performance responsibilities; contracts and coal requirement forecasts are separate from actual receipts.
items.summary_id: Subholding pembangkitan PLN yang bertanggung jawab pada operasi unit; kebutuhan batubara dan volume diterima perlu dicatat terpisah.

items.name: PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI)
items.summary_en: Provides railway freight network for PTBA coal logistics to Tarahan/Kertapati; not coal concession-holder.
items.summary_id: Menyediakan layanan angkutan kereta batubara PTBA menuju Tarahan/Kertapati; bukan pemegang konsesi tambang.

items.name: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk
items.summary_en: Listed private thermal-coal mining group, with mining operations through Adaro Indonesia and Balangan-related entities. Not a Danantara entity.
items.summary_id: Grup tambang batubara termal swasta terbuka, termasuk operasi Adaro Indonesia dan perusahaan Balangan; bukan perusahaan Danantara.

items.name: PT Adaro Indonesia
items.summary_en: Operates Tutupan and Wara mines; corporate disclosures identify an IUPK continuing operations in production; separate parent ownership from specific permit entity.
items.summary_id: Operator tambang Tutupan dan Wara; perusahaan menyebut dasar IUPK kelanjutan operasi, terpisah dari status induk usaha.

items.name: PT Bumi Resources Tbk
items.summary_en: Coal group linked to Kaltim Prima Coal and Arutmin operations; group sales, mine output and cash receipts must be separately reconciled.
items.summary_id: Grup batubara swasta terbuka yang berkaitan dengan KPC dan Arutmin; produksi, penjualan dan penerimaan kas berbeda.

items.name: PT Kaltim Prima Coal (KPC)
items.summary_en: Coal mine operator in East Kalimantan under a post-PKP2B IUPK; Bumi Resources publishes KPC's production and permit profile.
items.summary_id: Operator tambang Sangatta dan Bengalon di Kalimantan Timur dengan IUPK setelah PKP2B; profil operasional dan izin tersedia pada keterbukaan BUMI.

items.name: PT Arutmin Indonesia
items.summary_en: Operating Indonesian coal subsidiary of Bumi Resources with domestic and export customers; corporate ownership is distinct from government concessions.
items.summary_id: Operator batubara Kalimantan Selatan pada grup Bumi Resources bagi pasar domestik dan ekspor; kepemilikan berbeda dari konsesi pemerintah.

items.name: PT Bayan Resources Tbk
items.summary_en: Publicly listed private coal-mining group in East/North Kalimantan, with mine-to-port logistics; separate the holding from concession subsidiaries.
items.summary_id: Grup tambang batubara swasta terbuka di Kalimantan Timur/Utara dengan logistik tambang-ke-pelabuhan; bedakan induk dan pemegang IUP anak usaha.

items.name: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (ITM)
items.summary_en: Indonesian listed coal group with mines and related coal logistics; individual IUP and shipping throughput require subsidiary-level verification.
items.summary_id: Emiten batubara Indonesia yang memiliki tambang dan logistik terkait; izin dan volume pengiriman harus ditinjau per anak usaha.

items.name: PT Indika Energy Tbk
items.summary_en: Holding-company coal exposure through Kideco; its 2025 annual report notes Kideco as the largest consolidated revenue contributor.
items.summary_id: Grup energi swasta terbuka dengan eksposur batubara melalui Kideco; laporan tahunan 2025 menempatkan Kideco sebagai kontributor pendapatan terbesar.

items.name: PT Kideco Jaya Agung
items.lead: East Kalimantan private coal mine operator
items.summary_en: Mine operator within Indika's coal group; 2025 production disclosed as 30.5 million tonnes, but do not treat 2025 production as automatically carried into 2026.
items.summary_id: Operator tambang swasta grup Indika; laporan 2025 menyebut produksi 30,5 juta ton, tidak boleh otomatis dianggap realisasi 2026.

items.name: DMO coal allocations for electricity
items.lead: ESDM allocations + licensed suppliers / PLN demand
items.summary_en: Domestic supply policy involves the regulator, IUP/IUPK producers, PLN EPI, PLTU owners and other eligible consumers. An allocation is not evidence of delivery.
items.summary_id: Pasokan domestik melibatkan regulator, pemegang izin tambang, PLN EPI, pemilik PLTU, dan pengguna lainnya. Alokasi tidak sama dengan realisasi penyerahan.

items.name: Tarahan & Kertapati coal corridors
items.summary_en: PTBA connects mine conveyors and rail to Tarahan and Kertapati loading operations. Port handling and dispatch are different from national coal production.
items.summary_id: Rantai logistik PTBA dari konveyor dan kereta ke terminal Tarahan/Kertapati. Volume pelabuhan/angkut berbeda dari produksi nasional.

items.name: Private coal barging & transshipment operators
items.id_name: Operator tongkang & alih muat batubara swasta
items.summary_en: Licensed barges, tugboats, jetties and loading terminals connect inland mines to seaborne buyers; operators vary by concession and contract.
items.summary_id: Operator tongkang, tugboat, jetty, serta terminal berizin menghubungkan tambang ke kapal ekspor/domestik; aktor berbeda menurut kontrak.

items.name: Domestic industrial coal customers
items.summary_en: Coal demand extends beyond PLN thermal generation to cement, metallurgy and industrial boilers; do not classify all DMO tonnage as PLN supply.
items.summary_id: Permintaan domestik selain PLTU meliputi semen, metalurgi dan boiler industri; total DMO tidak seluruhnya diserap PLN.

items.name: APBI–ICMA coal industry association
items.summary_en: Industry association providing sector views and business advocacy; not a mining-regulation issuer or source of administrative permits.
items.summary_id: Asosiasi usaha pertambangan batubara yang memberi masukan industri; bukan penerbit aturan atau izin tambang.

items.name: International coal buyers and traders
items.summary_en: Exposure to Chinese, Indian and other Asian offtakers influences sales/prices, but private buyers do not determine Indonesia's official HBA regulation.
items.summary_id: Eksposur pembeli dan pedagang Tiongkok, India, dan Asia lain mempengaruhi permintaan/harga, tetapi bukan pembuat aturan HBA Indonesia.

items.name: DPR RI Commission XII
items.summary_en: Examines sector rules, government performance, DMO/HBA/RKAB policy and environmental issues, not the daily management of private mines.
items.summary_id: Mengawasi kebijakan minerba, DMO/HBA/RKAB, dan dampak lingkungan, bukan menjalankan tambang swasta.

items.name: DPR VI and DPR XI / Budget Committee
items.id_name: DPR Komisi VI, XI, dan Banggar
items.summary_en: Commission VI scrutinizes state enterprises; XI and Banggar examine fiscal revenue, tax, subsidies and macro budget implications. Keep committee jurisdictions separate.
items.summary_id: Komisi VI mengawasi BUMN; Komisi XI dan Banggar terkait penerimaan fiskal, pajak dan pembahasan APBN. Wewenang tidak boleh dicampur.

items.name: DPD RI Committee II
items.summary_en: Represents provincial mining, infrastructure, environmental and energy-access interests at national level; not a coal IUP issuer.
items.summary_id: Menyuarakan kepentingan daerah tambang, infrastruktur, lingkungan, dan akses energi di tingkat nasional; bukan penerbit IUP.

items.name: Coal-producing provincial governments
items.summary_en: Coordinate spatial, environmental and local logistics issues within delegated legal powers; licensing powers must be distinguished from central Minerba competencies.
items.summary_id: Menangani tata ruang, dampak lingkungan, dan logistik daerah dalam batas delegasi; kewenangan izin tidak boleh disamakan dengan pemerintah pusat.

items.name: BPS — coal & lignite GDP statistics
items.id_name: BPS — statistik PDB batubara dan lignit
items.summary_en: Publishes coal/lignite mining gross value added as a separate GDP subindustry; neither total mining GDP nor export FOB revenues should be mislabeled coal-only GDP.
items.summary_id: Menerbitkan nilai tambah bruto pertambangan batubara/lignit sebagai subkategori PDB; bukan seluruh PDB pertambangan atau nilai FOB ekspor.

items.name: BPK RI — public-finance audit
items.summary_en: Audits state financial management, including relevant public entities and government revenue; not the mine-licensing authority.
items.summary_id: Memeriksa pengelolaan keuangan negara dan penerimaan pemerintah/entitas yang menjadi kewenangannya; bukan pemberi izin pertambangan.

indicators.note_en: Current prices · BPS · provisional (**); mining value added, not exports
indicators.note_id: Harga berlaku · BPS · sementara (**); nilai tambah, bukan ekspor

indicators.note_en: ESDM / Ditjen Minerba · realized, not 2026 target
indicators.note_id: ESDM / Ditjen Minerba · realisasi, bukan target 2026

indicators.note_en: ESDM · all eligible domestic end-users, not just PLN
indicators.note_id: ESDM · termasuk pengguna domestik selain PLN

indicators.note_en: Minerals AND coal; not coal-only revenue; no claim of export receipts
indicators.note_id: Mineral DAN batubara; bukan penerimaan khusus batubara atau ekspor

Check IUP/IUPK/legacy PKP2B permit status company by company
Reconcile ESDM and corporate reporting for the same period
focus_id: Bedakan RKAB, target perusahaan dan tonase hasil tambang
Cocokkan ESDM dan laporan emiten pada periode sama

issues.en: DMO coal supply and PLTU shortages
issues.id_label: Pasokan DMO dan risiko kekurangan PLTU
focus: Allocation is not delivered coal; verify PLN EPI procurement, coal quality and plant stock
Compare plant-specific inventories with demand and freight bottlenecks
Do not presume all DMO serves PLN; industrial buyers count too
focus_id: Kuota bukan realisasi; cek PLN EPI, kualitas batubara, dan stok PLTU
Cocokkan stok per PLTU dengan kebutuhan dan hambatan angkut
Tidak seluruh DMO untuk PLN; pengguna industri juga termasuk

issues.en: Coal GDP, export value and state revenue
issues.id_label: PDB batubara, ekspor dan penerimaan negara
focus: BPS GDP value added is different from export sales value and corporate revenue
2025 PNBP Rp130.2tn covers minerals and coal, not just coal
Price changes and output volume have different effects on GDP, royalties and local budgets
focus_id: PDB BPS adalah nilai tambah, berbeda dari nilai penjualan ekspor/omzet
PNBP Rp130,2 T pada 2025 mencakup mineral dan batubara
Harga dan volume memengaruhi PDB, royalti serta anggaran daerah secara berbeda

issues.en: HBA reference prices and fiscal exposure
focus: Check the actual dated HBA reference and grade/calorific content
HBA is a royalty reference, not universal FOB/contract sale price
Check tax and royalty realization separately from quoted benchmark
focus_id: Periksa HBA bertanggal beserta kelas/kalori batubara
HBA acuan royalti, bukan semua harga transaksi FOB
Bedakan realisasi pajak/royalti dengan harga acuan

focus: Mine output, stockpile inventories, rail/river haulage and port throughput are distinct
Separate licensed exporter/trader, mining contractor and end-buyer
Watch shipping interruptions and affected electricity demand by location
focus_id: Produksi, stockpile, pengangkutan, dan throughput pelabuhan berbeda
Bedakan pemegang izin, pedagang, kontraktor angkutan, dan pembeli
Pantau gangguan logistik dan kebutuhan PLTU menurut lokasi

issues.en: Coal emissions, mine closure and transition
issues.id_label: Emisi batubara, penutupan tambang dan transisi
focus: Coal mining GDP and dispatch dependence must be balanced against climate and rehabilitation obligations
Assess rehabilitation guarantees, local jobs, post-mining plans and future power replacement
Do not equate pledged closure or phase-down with a commissioned replacement plant
focus_id: Nilai PDB dan ketergantungan pasokan harus dianalisis bersama kewajiban iklim/reklamasi
Uji jaminan reklamasi, pekerja lokal, pascatambang dan pengganti kapasitas listrik
Komitmen penutupan bukan bukti pembangkit pengganti sudah beroperasi
